tool_args.rationale: The pilot identifies the siphon baseline, and the three high-gradient rows identify a threshold near 2.60 and a penalty slope near 1.567. The five-parameter law fits the paid observations to rounding precision. Submit it for fresh confirmation against the 0.045 RMSE tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It matches the five pilot rows but overpredicts all three high-gradient measurements. The deficit divided by u_now grows linearly with s_grad above the fitted onset.
The threshold law already fits all eight measurements to their reported precision at the target horizon, so trajectory data are not needed to identify its parameters.
